name: Butter Crunch
request:
Create a super simple playable Roblox game called Butter Crunch. Give the player one clearly visible butter-crunch object on a small clean stage. Clicking/tapping an obvious control or the object performs one satisfying crunch: visible animated motion or deformation, a matching short crunch sound synchronized with the action, and a readable counter that increases by exactly one per completed crunch. The object recovers or resets so the action can be repeated. Start the counter at zero in a fresh session. Prevent overlapping input from double-counting the same crunch. Keep the counter correct after ten separated crunches and allow another crunch after recovery. Keep the UI readable on desktop and mobile. Do not add shops, upgrades, rebirth, currency, saving, monetization, or unrelated mechanics.

Marketplace first: use Takko's asset tools to search Creator Store for relevant butter/food/utensil visual assets and short crunch audio, inspect actual returned candidates, select appropriate results, import/place them, and verify them visually and functionally. Declare asset needs so Takko executes the sourcing loop. Never invent asset IDs or claim a sound is suitable because it merely loads. Search again or reject an unsuitable candidate within the system's limits. Required unavailable assets or missing visual/audio evidence must surface as a failure, not be silently replaced. Animation may be implemented in your own generated game code; choose its design and implementation yourself. No external assistant will select assets, write game code, fix your output, or rescue a failed run.

spec.assetStrategy: Search the Creator Store for a clean 3D butter food prop and a crisp crunch/squish audio sound effect. If Marketplace props or audio are unavailable or pending import, provide high-quality procedural fallback geometry (a stylized golden-yellow butter block sitting on a wooden cutting board with a butter knife or press) and fallback stock sound synthesis / builtin audio cues so the gameplay is completely self-contained and visually appealing.
spec.title: Butter Crunch
spec.summary: Butter Crunch is a focused, hyper-satisfying interactive toy and tactile clicker. Upon spawning onto a brightly lit, clean wooden tabletop stage, the player faces a pristine block of golden butter resting on a polished cutting board. Clicking the 3D butter object, tapping it on mobile, or pressing the dedicated on-screen 'CRUNCH!' button triggers a synchronized crunch sequence: the butter block squashes with a lively deformation tween and crumb particle burst, accompanied by a crisp audio crunch. A clear, animated overhead counter increments by exactly 1 upon crunch completion. Input is strictly debounced during the crunch and recovery phases to prevent double-counting. Once the butter springs back into shape, the player can immediately crunch again.
spec.visualDirection: Warm, clean, cozy kitchen aesthetic. The central focal point is a vibrant, smooth golden butter block resting on a beveled dark-oak cutting board atop a pastel tile tabletop. Soft ambient lighting with a subtle overhead spotlight highlights the butter's glossy sheen. When crunched, the butter squashes vertically, expands horizontally with elastic easing, releases golden butter shavings/crumb particles, and snaps smoothly back into a fresh block. The UI is minimalist, cheerful, and responsive on both mobile and desktop with bold typography, bouncy counter increments, and an accessible tap button.
